inputs.goal: compare Snowflake, BigQuery and Redshift for our warehouse migration

collect.map.shard_result: BigQuery leads with $0.02/GB/hour pricing, 'Very High' performance, 'Excellent' scalability, and 'Excellent' integration. Redshift has the highest pricing at $0.25/GB/hour with 'High' performance, 'Good' scalability, and 'Good' integration. BigQuery provides the best overall value proposition for warehouse migration.

Redshift has the highest pricing at $0.25/GB/hour compared to Snowflake's $0.03/GB/hour and BigQuery's $0.02/GB/hour, making it the most expensive option. The integration is rated as Good for all three platforms.
